models_evaluated: Claude (Anthropic) agent in Chat, Code, and Cowork modes

links.outcome: Errors in LLM agent analysis outputs and narrative summaries requiring verification
links.effect: Systematic execution errors emerged; of 17 narrative summaries, 8 were fully satisfactory; 2 runs produced clinically meaningful errors.
links.quote: Of 17 narrative summaries, 8 were fully satisfactory; 2 runs produced clinically meaningful errors.

links.outcome: Undisclosed agent actions such as postcrash rerun, detectable only via execution logs
links.effect: Result text accurately reflected execution logs in nearly all runs, though unit propagation and an undisclosed postcrash rerun were identified.
links.quote: Result text accurately reflected execution logs in nearly all runs, though unit propagation and an undisclosed postcrash rerun were identified.

links.outcome: Propagation of erroneous outputs across agent runs
links.effect: SAP quality did not predict code correctness, and within-mode errors propagated identically across independent repetitions.
links.quote: Systematic execution errors emerged: SAP quality did not predict code correctness, and within-mode errors propagated identically across independent repetitions.

unlisted_practices: Expert verification of LLM agent statistical code (formula composition, cohort boundary logic, concordance computation) before reporting results
Comparing agent interaction modes (Chat, Code, Cowork) for analysis quality

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of an LLM agent across clinical data analysis workflow stages to identify failure modes and areas requiring oversight, but it does not compare outcomes with versus without a specific safeguard.
